title: OPENINGBALANCEMONTH evaluates the expression on the last date of the previous month
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", OPENINGBALANCEMONTH ( [Sales], 'Date'[Date] ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 3, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 3, 31 ) )

source.quote: Evaluates the specified expression for the date corresponding to the end of the previous month after applying specified filters.
OPENINGBALANCEMONTH uses the last date of the previous month in the Dates column or in the calendar.
source.supports: not the first date of the current month

derivation: The month before March 2024 ends on February 29, 2024; sales on that date are 400.
